Running out of title ideas until I start just adding numbers/dates I guess, but thought it's cool to add what I've done today, especially since some people around here seem to barely be around anymore. Maybe it'd encourage more people to actively log about their workings. 

On the scrobble.life side of things

### Our extension is now available for install on Chrome Web Store!

This is the big news of today as it'll make installing it so much easier for users, where as in the past they had to jump over a few hurdles to do so. 

##### You can find the extension here: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hive-scrobbler/nmiakhpbilkpimeohngjbjickchkcpio

Currently unlisted and awaiting an update approval, but will be made public shortly after! 

For Mozilla users, it's been public for some time now: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/hive-scrobbler/

_Would appreciate some feedback/reviews on the pages if you install it!_ 

We had a request today to add a light/day mode to the website, surprisingly, so I went ahead and did that. Went for a warm white color I thought was fitting and then changed a few irregularities that stood out where font color remained white, etc.

Looks like this: 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23xAuFEqvDJwvL8enuxCo8mA6HFw1UQiSvJuCHfaeVJLqTnaTE9GEEK4vbjACA6JoLszz.png)

Users can toggle light/dark mode in the lower left corner of the website. 

Some thing we may need to start tackling soon is mobile responsiveness for the website as I haven't looked into that much at all, even though react should be good with it by default, this site is quite focused towards pc browsers due to the extension being tied to it. 

Fixed some issues with lyrics being behind, part of it were due to hive nodes going down. 

___

On the decentmemes.com side of things

We did some changes today to the /submit page. Now it requires you to enter you hive account at the top instead before you submit a template and hive keychain posting op when you do submit one.

This is to prevent flooding of templates while giving everyone a chance to submit 1 per day for free, just to be a bit more careful about it rather than spraying wildly. We also don't wanna overload hive.blog/peakd image hosting too much if no one's going to ever use your templates just cause you're trying to spam to hopefully generate some passive earnings from them. 

The submission is also gated to hive reputation over 60, which may be changed later. 

If you wanna submit more than 1 template that day, there is now a cost of 1 hive which gets burned: 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/243qPoanCwPH5xEkn3A7aJybYKZuvGm52Huji3j5fyhCuAb13jpqmgcqyHEow4YfWns2Q.png)


This keeps the project non-profit and adds a small buffer to the flooding we've seen recently. 
Keep in mind that submissions may still be denied even if you paid for it and that there's no refund since you burn the hive before it goes through. 

Anyway, that's pretty much it, if you have questions, feel free to ask! 

Thanks for reading and trying out and using the apps above! 

I'll be continuing on unity development for a while moving forward while keeping an eye on the other projects!

An entire post about strawberries? Watch me 😊 

Initially, I didn't plan to talk a lot about my strawberries, but I was so surprised when I came to the garden today that I decided I had to share it with you. It's been rainy and cold for the last four days, so I didn't go to the garden, and I didn't expect to see so many ripe strawberries after such a cold weather. My brother in law is getting married on Friday. I'm leaving tomorrow early in the morning and will be back only on Sunday, so I went to the garden to see if anything urgent needed to be done and then I saw them. Well, these babies should receive a lot of attention...

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EouBY6UtJFH73w6foV3BPaP4ciqiCqBFuSzwaqYnC8HbYFP14sYAaMmwFzKnNtfnMFs.jpg)
----
I know that many gardeners consider growing strawberries scary as so many things can go wrong and all their effort could be for nothing. I didn't want to go through all the trouble because of a few strawberries, so I have never planted them before. My lovely neighbour has been asking me for years to take some of her offshoot plants and give growing strawberries a go. I kept resisting, but she can be very persuasive, so I caved in last autumn. 

I prepared a bed at the border of the garden where I had potatoes before as she told me that potatoes make good soil for strawberries. I planted more than 30 plants and kept watering them every day for a couple of weeks before forgetting about them completely. As I said last time, I was really surprised that every single plant survived winter even though I didn't cover them - hard little things. 

I loosened the soil and removed the weeds way too late, and hoped for the best. The plants are not very big, but they are loaded with strawberries. 

It all starts with tender white blossom waiting for pollinators. I have plenty of insects as my garden is full of beneficial plants, so I kept being positive. 

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EpVDbDPNrjxoHuQYzxZa97QRHhBPWFZPzYPVPj1mzFnVX74PVTN6jyDXnDPnRhSfss9.jpg)
----
After a couple of week I started to see fruits. At this stage I placed a lot of straw under the plants which has multiple benefits. It helps to retain water, so that I don't have to water the plants every day. The fruit doesn't touch the soil which prevents them from rotting. It also helps keeping them clean. 

One plant got attacked by ants, and I let the nature take its own course and now they are gone. I have no idea what happened, but there are no ants to be seen. Great! 

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoK9ggiQa3RpKWWEW4bCsr5q94jzDiVT627BnoKWf2WAhkAxDD6Q7VKX4uYqgpcQecf.jpg)
----
Once they start turning pink it goes very fast. There are so many strawberries ripening at the moment and I hope that they will not rot before I get to them on Monday. 

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Ep1Zm1FdK1kmrvWtH46cCiuVXiW9pThQuwHL8CKE9bkD2HJBd6mouafRcD59KYPi7yw.jpg)
----
This gives me so much joy! When I was a child I had to garden every single day and I hated it. It was so much work and I couldn't play with my friends. These days I appreciate it so much. It's the best kind of therapy for me. 

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoeHMbJLsy9Cyb76m6nADSi1i3FADJQiH85QMw7ya17vww1LdB16TstZgzpRnngcBj2.jpg)
----
I pick the red ones in hope that it will push the plants to produce more...

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoCkbLqSCdH6Jj3RhAf4cttmXwZtEGHsi4c7tEttiSvMburZxmrbcq8Zt5XsMrE9Ub5.jpg)

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Eos5anUYhzeWxCdH3TyBVEzGeyw1vSeou5hEcEooikbgusYnvounAEctUapdhcy4WnM.jpg)

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Ep1ZMWC7yxWKpM5bQb1SK6ou1cGwwiGdb2K6dK7cp4n4Et8rpBz38De3AYdHZw3sk3v.jpg)

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoyTMNA8aiJqXZebMrz2qGpGU52AjYH2QaSqZwo2jomF2MSpoupNVA431ECFxzHCCem.jpg)
----
This one is so big! Of course, I sent all these photos to my husband to make him a little bit jealous as he is travelling at the moment. 

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoySyBkUw9ixmcvatgJkQehzbKT66vYhp4ebx3ayCzqReFBdB4dGY1neghMChga6koA.jpg)

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EopwGJrU3AgVK42fspqgUeiso4xYfWqcRkDQCRv9ky5C9t5dNUBvsyoEjDTXiLkh67K.jpg)
----
And yes, I had to taste them and in the end ate all of them in the garden...

They have already started to make offshoots, so there will be new plants in the autumn for next year. And I'm sure that my lovely neighbour will give me even more. Now, when I know how to grow them I'm planning to cover my entire garden in strawberries 😊

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EopuJPk8sLbPGRrcnYSrc88719eyahBxQVSQ1Kn2msVxX64vckdvzHSykrdos2FdtGr.jpg)
----
I also have tons of wild/forest strawberries. This is an entirely different story as they grow like weed. You don't need to do anything and they keep spreading and covering the area that I designated for them. I must admit that I prefer them to the garden strawberries, but they are just so tiny that I never have enough. 

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Eo8SHi2nRuRzAqD6n26Cq3bAxaxUABSmXVuBPCB9tB44YPGgUFeLnbavQi1tbae9ffH.jpg)
----
I think that they will be ready when I'm back on Monday...

![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoEq1J6SXpnra6WvLTSayNmppQeFmhCcc7k12Dd69Mpyc29YdjNaBpEC199q9pxh4pJ.jpg)
---
They look in the full sun or partial shade, and you can place them in an open space or under some shrubs. Mine are growing under the red currants. 

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EoEpY6ucd2CDbRiDRRc7tCr4nnTkhwWMCVXNPATAWJ1Css6v3sgAeVrNskGMTM8XQg6.jpg)
----
Look how tiny they are!

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/EpA31oYrtPtrEjjpRtnqtHz7CaqoQcYh4CDVoTR5ChuTNDvcCkmW2XCJEHUnTmzVVHr.jpg)

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/plantfuljourney/Ep5oczeZ9Mq1aToXACaoah7VSUji9BRU9ta6YVoahEBzHPneuL4PsNu71w7sy7scPNp.jpg)
-----
Thank you for letting me share my excitement with you.

Until next time...

Yesterday I was watching a series called "Legends", which is a about an undercover operation to annihilate drug cartels and is playing in the early 90's. The team is made of ad-hoc trained civil servants, custom officers and the situations they got themselves involved in give you a heart attack sometimes, but not because those are so good, but because of how our mind works today. At least mine I'd say. ![objecttype-raw-qY8Y4uU2nf8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoeENap2YatjJvJCLj6Jya77BPpLHDUtAmXr84x1tF4Xt9nXymuQ4qtNC7BHu7NGbJp.jpg) Photo by ObjectType RAW on Unsplash As I said earlier, the series is featuring life in the early 90's and the undercover agents get themselves in all kinds of unexpected situations, like it happens when you infiltrate a criminal gang. You are watching them breaking into warehouses or flats by picking a lock with two pins and the first thing you think of is "you stupid idiot, the CCTV is recording you". But is it? Nope it isn't as there were no cameras back then or video surveillance was not so wide spread and not available for everyone. Picking a lock is one thing but when they open the door, the first thing you think of is "the alarm is going to go off" and you expect to hear the sound of it. That is not happening as there was no alarm system in every location back then. ![ricky-t-bdO2tB5v_lc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23yJLUSMHURtBL3XXLgeYhdtvps7VptdNAxHyfGo9cPgafLPjjiWmSshiA8vZ3r3rnTuk.jpg) Photo by Ricky T on Unsplash Today I was wondering how much these things change your movie watching experience. Are you able to disconnect your brain from reality and focus only on what you see, without noticing these things? Another funny thing I have to mention. The undercover guy steps into a phone booth and calls his wife. He has a mobile phone as well, one with an extendable antenna as those were the latest back then, but that phone is for communicating with his underworld contacts only. So the guy makes the call, exits he booth and he's safe. His suspicious business partners can only trace his call if they bribe someone at the telecommunication company as there was no redial the last number option. Today you can have as many phones you like, or as many as your pocket can afford, but can you make a call from a public phone? Do you know any working payphone in your area? I don't. ![intricate-explorer-6lWd5GRD1-E-unsplash(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xVTm62mE9NvMLephMZFrQpRK3qVS4PZgtXVuVcCg2LeBMzwu2sSsWyuQXPAEtTRTXYR.jpg) Photo by Intricate Explorer on Unsplash I'm not a spy, even though some say I am, because of my language skills, but was thinking how much difficult it is to be a spy today, compared to what it used to be before the digital era. You need a lot of skills and I think many are still using old tricks as those are untraceable, or more difficult to detect. ![intricate-explorer---DGj9s5OfI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xydLcUgMYGrptVNnz51GL1FRBfDyVtTVYGKwKG2LRuMWTyMfVHqw7pqF3s1XtEJj4B6.jpg) Photo by Intricate Explorer on Unsplash There's something new every day and what was top technology yesterday, it is obsolete today. You watch these situations in different movies and you know at least five better solutions for that matter and you don't even know the half of it, you only know what you see in the movies. A couple of years ago I saw a Bond movie from the early times, with Sean Connery starring and the feeling I had was very different from what the director wanted to achieve in people with the movie. It was the 60's, obviously life and technology were very different, but it shows you how far we've come. ![onur-kurt-SVKuw0IeDmY-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xp8Z3psf79vRoMcBGiUYzpWgtYiLWwZovcdsYqGFSkEdn7ng6qEF9H6LTt28v6yN7kh.jpg) Photo by ONUR KURT on Unsplash You need to disconnect the present from your brain and just enjoy what you see, without thinking I guess. Otherwise it's going to ruin the whole experience for you. Or maybe it's just me, who is thinking this way. Who knows?

These little plants have been in the ground for almost two weeks. And appear to be adjusting well, lots of lush green and I see more leaves forming. Big leaves to take in all that sunlight we are getting now. Its been really bright and hot, getting into the 90F's throughout the day. I have had to water them a few times as we are in a major drought right now. But luckily they are calling for a good amount of rain over the next week. So I think I can stop for now and let the sky do its thing. No need to add fertilizer, its all in the soil and should last many months. Hopefully until flowering at the least.

https://i.postimg.cc/C5gBJzTw/20260520-105959.jpg

https://i.postimg.cc/hj4MPVZP/A1.png Strain:|Desfrán |
-|-|
https://i.postimg.cc/3NVZBV8d/B3.png Dominance: | 100% sativa
https://i.postimg.cc/FRPpf1wb/C2.png Nutrients used: | Happy Frog Soil / Ocean Forest soil. Big Bloom, Grow big:All FoxFarm products.
https://i.postimg.cc/D08g1nK9/D3.png Lineage: | Destroyer x Meao Thai landrace
https://i.postimg.cc/KcHQxkPx/E2.png Current growing stage: | Vegetative |
https://i.postimg.cc/8Pf45p4W/F1.png Current plant age: | 61 days old
https://i.postimg.cc/vZRzxJ2K/G2.png Sex: | Feminized
https://i.postimg.cc/YC1x6dJC/H1.png Location: | Central Virginia

https://i.postimg.cc/JnJHbjgz/20260520-105957.jpg

Really happy to see them recover, sucks I still lost one. But the three are coming along nicely. I think they like the soil I provided. I added some plain potting soil right where they are planted. And then fertilizer rich soil is on the edges and deep in the hole. So when their roots grow they will find it, by that time they will want lots of nutrients.

https://i.postimg.cc/L5pYvnK8/20260520-110012.jpg

This part of the outdoor grow tends to go well, its more of an issue when they start flowering. With tightly packed buds they tend to get mildew inside, such as indica buds are by structure. So by going with a pure sativa, I hope the buds are more airy and resist any mildew build up.

https://i.postimg.cc/sxrQKvdf/20260520-110015.jpg

But I do hope by picking genetics that come from humid environments should help with the flowering period when they start to show signs of too much moisture in the buds.

https://i.postimg.cc/wMpyF78T/20260520-110019.jpg

But for now and many months, until late summer they should be growing lots of leaves. Hopefully becoming some large plants.

https://i.postimg.cc/tJjZDYQ1/20260520-110117.jpg

The forth hole is not doing much, the seed I planted I have not seen break the surface. I am going to wait a few more days and then start a new seed inside, using those plantable pots I talked about in previous posts.

https://i.postimg.cc/GtC8zHwD/20260520-110224.jpg

They are hard to see now, but those three plants should get pretty big in a few months I think. Right now they are barely a foot tall, but now they are adjusting I think we will see lots of growth.

Looking forward to checking on them after the rains pass through the area, at this point if I wait a day or two I can really notice the difference in growth. So I think they should be interesting to observe and I will see them get nice and big soon.

![Kopia – Whispers (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xexRVGgmAPZqedUzgfCPcphXbF9tNgq2XcUp9MpmU48qbXsWjUqasPt4abf25UZp2ZU.jpg)

Last year in October I had an unloading in MANRESA in Spain. Fortunately for me the unloading was scheduled for Monday, while I arrived there already on Saturday morning. That meant I had the entire weekend ahead of me and plenty of free time. 😁
I managed to find a parking spot very close to the unloading location and at the same time not far from the center of MANRESA. I also had my bicycle with me, but since the city center was only about three kilometers away, I decided to go there on foot.
I must admit that I later regretted that decision a little. The walk turned out to be much more exhausting than I had initially expected. On top of that the weather was exceptionally sunny. Even though it was already October, summer in Spain was still in full swing and the temperature felt much more like the middle of summer than autumn.

MANRESA itself is not a large city. It has a population of around 75,000 people, which is only slightly more than the city where I currently live. However I must admit that for a relatively small city, it surprised me with both the number and the monumentality of its historic landmarks. There are several true architectural gems to be found here.
One of them is the SANCTUARY OF THE CAVE OF SAINT IGNATIUS, a place that made a huge impression on me from the very first sight. And it is photographs from this remarkable place that I would like to show you today.



>W zeszłym roku w październiku miałam rozładunek w MANRESIE w Hiszpanii. Na moje szczęście rozładunek był zaplanowany dopiero na poniedziałek, a na miejsce dotarłam już w sobotę rano. Oznaczało to, że miałam przed sobą cały weekend i sporo wolnego czasu.
Udało mi się znaleźć parking bardzo blisko miejsca rozładunku, a jednocześnie niedaleko centrum MANRESY. Miałam ze sobą również rower, jednak ponieważ do centrum było zaledwie około trzech kilometrów, postanowiłam wybrać się tam pieszo.
Muszę przyznać, że później trochę żałowałam tej decyzji. Spacer okazał się znacznie bardziej wyczerpujący, niż początkowo zakładałam. Dodatkowo pogoda była wyjątkowo słoneczna. Pomimo że był już październik, lato w Hiszpanii wciąż trwało w najlepsze i temperatura zdecydowanie bardziej przypominała środek wakacji niż jesień.
>
>Sama MANRESA nie jest dużym miastem. Liczy około 75 tysięcy mieszkańców, a więc niewiele więcej niż miasto, w którym obecnie mieszkam. Muszę jednak przyznać, że jak na stosunkowo niewielkie miasto, bardzo zaskoczyła mnie liczbą oraz monumentalnością swoich zabytków. Znajduje się tutaj kilka prawdziwych perełek architektonicznych.
Jedną z nich jest właśnie SANCTUARY OF THE CAVE OF SAINT IGNATIUS, miejsce, które zrobiło na mnie ogromne wrażenie już od pierwszego spojrzenia. I właśnie zdjęcia z tego niezwykłego miejsca chciałabym wam dzisiaj pokazać.

To begin with, I would like to show you a few photographs that I managed to take during the golden hour, when the entire sanctuary was beautifully illuminated by the warm evening light. The photos do not fully convey just how enormous this complex really is, but I hope they give at least a small impression of its scale.

All of the remaining photographs of the sanctuary were taken earlier in the day and from a much closer distance. Because of that, you will probably notice quite a significant difference in lighting conditions between the images. The golden-hour photographs have a much warmer atmosphere, while the later close-up shots reveal more architectural details and decorative elements that are easy to miss from afar.

>Na początek wstawiam kilka fotek, które udało mi się zrobić już o złotej godzinie, pokazujące całe sanktuarium w swojej krasie. Na zdjęciach oczywiście nie widać do końca jak bardzo ogromne jest to sanktuarium. Jednak mam nadzieję, że potraficie sobie to wyobrazić choć troszeczkę.
>
>Reszta zdjęć tego sanktuarium była robiona z bliższej odległości o wcześniejszej porze. Także różnica światła na zdjęciach będzie dosyć spora.


![20251001_183744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ynSenHxGE7BkDGmARm6Utnx547ZWxKZff7s2zRmSrZ9MYxXmBiNrGxKnEo9wkdEJg1s.jpg)

![20251001_184834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zbDA1V96HtY95UiJK5ah3LrHCDYkkSW6uy2GH4Ksvdrsz6QLCcX9PxeKYgV73AasLCx.jpg)

![20251001_190026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/2449wwKW2r8iWfvdsqppHz2fmEA4z6rDuASaPixHSubZo4ur8duQZ8TpDcxDZu7JK3ShH.jpg)

![20251001_190219.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23yJC9xSVJHqh8YVZmskzYedqwQ98RzspYaK1MLfCymmKDHjGRHPHtX5fV2aWzZDSFAsE.jpg)

The Sanctuary takes its name from SAINT IGNATIUS, who stayed in MANRESA between 1522 and 1523. This was undoubtedly a very important period in his life. It was here in MANRESA that Saint Ignatius underwent a profound spiritual transformation and it was also here that the foundations of the "Spiritual Exercises" were developed, a work that later became known throughout the world.

>Nazwa sanktuarium wywodzi się na cześć ŚWIĘTEGO IGNACEGO, który przebywał w Manresie w latach 1522 i 1523. Był to niewątpliwie bardzo ważny okres w jego życiu i to właśnie w Manresie święty Ignacy doznał ogromnej przemiany duchowej, a w późniejszym czasie powstały "ćwiczenia duchowe", które są znane na całym świecie.



![20251001_160414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23x17QPmtc3xrNuyJg7N6nPPQzii3Ycf2VULvEnSiwLhstLkU3fFKD7gTrm24KWWBeQF6.jpg)

![20251001_160611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ywoAjUooVV63bCMmf6yuwKaHVh5frb2rucTbC1H48iMbTHYCUBDfA4bPRkG3Q2aYx1m.jpg)

![20251001_161824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242DGJLM4oyBz1DZ2CRJ7mJXJpmWjUvexPYXEA8ysuC1PGkQCWQrECQ5jS1FVnca4wFbE.jpg)

![20251001_161955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23y8qerBbheYgbZyohtgJkJWVyGAAeActDVtWUK5A8pSNrWrwRUv8ztkgcrXz37cm5UuJ.jpg)

![20251001_162149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242rrwVt351dVUfzy8Z5ctLUHeHCBLxR1VQqnbWYuiNAvY6xaVVjRvSffERcrmmRpNkAR.jpg)

![20251001_162406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/241tVC1Kw4xJBjorTLHsij2FTuY2WnhJppXzLSLws81gRFqD8i1LdKD7s1hJV8pS6RpNN.jpg)

As you have probably noticed, I took a lot of photographs of this sanctuary. But with a place of such monumental scale, incredible attention to detail and unique architecture, interesting compositions seemed to appear everywhere I looked. Every few steps I discovered another detail, another perspective or another frame worth capturing.

I should also mention that I did not get to see the sanctuary from every side. Two sides of the complex were enclosed by walls, which limited access to certain viewpoints. Because of that I was unable to fully walk around the entire building, but ven the areas that were accessible provided more than enough opportunities for photography.

>Jak pewnie możecie zauważyć, zrobiłam bardzo dużo zdjęć tej katedry, ale przy takiej monumentalności i szczegółowości w detalach i całej tej wyjątkowości kompozycje same mi się układały i wszędzie widziałam jakieś ciekawe kadry. A muszę też powiedzieć, że nie widziałam tego sanktuarium z każdej strony, ponieważ z dwóch stron sanktuarium było otoczone murem.


![20251001_162431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ynQgYcym6kDWxNjc7Rxj6cfDkyoxZUvpFtjnHSVVSEJdYaSLjCGct895dkEeB1yNkCH.jpg)

![20251001_162438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xefxCB8caeehVEY9BoxLxmnmx6H5eqS6aUTc7ekvhTPyoAugwd9RS1qvfpwfdCZc7UR.jpg)

![20251001_162445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xyVDDJk8cTNn2jjvvAjDU7wnQqQX6GYTnW2paDvj9MGwLaAeryWuT3j7ddYB8RGCXCM.jpg)

![20251001_163212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zRtRZunPzk8UecgYQeSQSwwsmdx8sQ9zTezR1vYrt78XRxrmKiQGA7cGGoXxb1uRVo8.jpg)

![20251001_163333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242rnvcg1ZPsadtWoPDP7mPs4mNRBNZVxRgsgtKZFY3eFGM643Yb67ymaQJowZTiLA1oN.jpg)

The most difficult part was photographing the sanctuary from the front. A tree was growing directly in front of the main entrance, blocking most of the view, and even the wide-angle mode on my camera was unable to capture the entire front facade in a single frame.

>Najtrudniej było sfotografować katedrę od frontu, gdyż tuż przed drzwiami wejściowymi rosło sobie drzewo, które zasłaniało cały widok i nawet tryb aparatu szerokokątnego nie poradził sobie z objęciem frontowej ściany w całości.


![20251001_160423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23y8j45BVsbz4uN3LQkFpskJyrKzbpm7RLoJuk29wkiGzxNEPxeWxXLH7mbpeDiGYXkYK.jpg)

![20251001_161551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wqbykTiZhXDL7e1CKek5kAKFPDjk6DRpV9YFj26fy4MdP1wRbHpvvihxrQqoJWrL5w6.jpg)

I also took a few photographs of the architectural details. The sanctuary was so richly decorated that it was difficult to decide which details were worth photographing. Everywhere I looked I discovered another interesting fragment of the facade and before I knew it, the number of photos I had taken was growing faster than yeast dough. 😁

When we take a closer look, we can see that every part of the facade was crafted with extraordinary care. It is hard to believe that most of these decorations were created hundreds of years ago, at a time when craftsmen certainly did not have access to the tools and technology that we have today.

>Zrobiłam również kilka zdjęć detali architektonicznych. Katedra była tak bogato zdobiona, że trudno było się zdecydować, które detale warto sfotografować. Co rusz znajdowałam kolejny ciekawy fragment fasady i tym sposobem liczba wykonanych zdjęć rosła szybciej niż ciasto na drożdżach. 😁 
>
> Gdy przyjrzymy się bliżej, możemy zobaczyć, iż każdy fragment takiej fasady został wykonany z niezwykłą starannością. Aż trudno uwierzyć, że większość tych dekoracji powstała setki lat temu, gdzie z pewnością nie mieli do dyspozycji takich takich narzędzi, jakie my mamy dzisiaj



![20251001_160553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vi4EYcQdfwrcDG1Utm9KhZcFiYWj37NSx2qk4spYNJ97DmAJcYo5SfNrjbcPmKci8jD.jpg)

![20251001_161528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/AK2DjZ8VnfjdFVQUUZoyHWJQRBfLB3QrTjgvjft2mZJdXmjuCwaVPVy887CkjSy.jpg)

![20251001_161532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vsQY4hQ9SKvNnCoJbNc9HGe2vKaNScWHzW8pwWzPBfA6dAyUUpUMMCWwLU3XGYGzQgg.jpg)

![20251001_161539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tH5oWMfyVgSRCNVjfmoVebvP5GSrr6ETCsLBRUpvscbHadXuc8kEmKVrEuD877bkXe1.jpg)

The doors of the sanctuary were open, so I stepped inside. I must admit that I was greeted by a very bright and richly decorated interior, with gold being the dominant color throughout the church. My attention was immediately drawn to the walls and decorative elements. They stand out against the historic architecture and create a very interesting blend of tradition and more modern sacred art.

Inside a strong sense of symmetry can also be seen. The high vaulted ceilings, the regular arrangement of the arches, and of course the centrally placed altar all guide the eye toward the heart of the sanctuary, creating a harmonious and balanced space.

>Drzwi świątyni były otwarte, także weszłam do środka i muszę powiedzieć, iż zastałam bardzo jasne, bogato zdobione wnętrze, a dominującym kolorem był kolor złoty. Moją uwagę przyciągnęły oczywiście ściany świątyni. Wyróżniają się one na tle historycznej architektury i tworzą bardzo fajne połączenie tradycji z nowszą sztuką sakralną. 
>
>We wnętrzu możemy również zobaczyć sporą symetrię. Wysokie sklepienia, regularny układ arkad i oczywiście ołtarz umieszczony centralnie.


![20251001_160953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zba8fAVhfx9B8qYSmihPrZbtCEXGCwTiSy8cCDTYDEHdTLfppwXi3zWGpm8a3RumVhQ.jpg)

![20251001_160958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xpCr89TUcW8yL7YaAUmPxucxkWM3ah145NouSV6eDwEdSrUYM2s39h5q31271WKbmBr.jpg)

![20251001_161434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23uFgbiuYkE8CaMu5kMYoYezutS9nwzUN3Z3CtQBQD4gTJSovrAusrhpT1xZCTpNKCZEy.jpg)

![20251001_161448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tvuUaHhirs133P66UtwPjanxvAosjEojbvBQZkBkzuSeK7WS8y1C5VwkvHz9Bcga35C.jpg)

![20251001_161458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/Eoc8XiSwwFw9eQCeDpauJnrmK8svxCC9VD71yEN6spoXonuDfoYtgS59yssTWsqDs8s.jpg)

![20251001_161503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xerTwL6CGzsZLQs3vqhvBNMEUrcvyWeWeqmSovbgqPjnvH9UpWWLYT7JXd3NgXxRSCt.jpg)

The Sanctuary of Saint Ignatius was built in stages over many decades. Its richly decorated facade was not completed until the eighteenth century and is now regarded as one of the finest examples of Baroque architecture associated with the Jesuit Order in Catalonia.

The interior of the sanctuary was also modified and expanded several times over the centuries. As a result, alongside Baroque elements, visitors can also find decorations originating from much later periods. Thanks to this, the sanctuary has become a unique chronicle of the history of sacred art, where different artistic styles and eras coexist within the same building.


>Sanktuarium świętego Ignacego powstawało etapami przez wiele dziesięcioleci. Jego bogato zdobiona fasada została ukończona dopiero w osiemnastym wieku i obecnie uznawana jest za jeden z najcenniejszych przykładów architektury barokowej związanej z zakonem jezuitów w Katalonii. 
>
>Również wnętrze sanktuarium było wielokrotnie zmieniane i uzupełniane. W poszczególnych stuleciach. Dlatego też oprócz elementów barokowych można znaleźć również dekoracje pochodzące z dużo późniejszych okresów. Dzięki temu świątynia ta stała się swoistą kroniką historii sztuki sakralnej.

![1000204434.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2ysjubjzRwD7UpvEJQCuxmY82pnayAN67cEcvYH4s1uoApfAH1TcUFMiL5LaVzE5gc.png)

Have a blessed day everyone! I hope you're all doing well. Yesterday was such a tiring but happy day for me. I had so many things to do for our upcoming fiesta, so I started my day early processing important errands. I went to the market, bought materials we needed for the celebration, and had our tarpaulin printed. The weather was extremely hot, and I was already feeling exhausted from going from one place to another.


![1000204278.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xVCupU11h5WaWx3LU9xHwTUgL5uNyzqMeAQBuR2Yexawk7NNxMztNrPsLLPy7cNwNPZ.jpg)

Aside from the fiesta preparations, I also needed to buy a gift for my mom because her birthday happens at the same time as our fiesta. Sadly, I could not attend her birthday celebration because I needed to focus on our responsibilities for the event. Thankfully, my mom completely understands. Instead, I bought groceries, cake and gift for her birthday celebration so she could still enjoy her special day with the family.

![1000204364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xL2VsexNDL7gGum8HjsC4oqFQzWWGr2opauyf78FxSuZ4kQRyn3q51Z6aXvY5oAbA4Y.jpg)


![1000204353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zGo1z46ZaRzqRFWSikwZDLiEJee4G7Vq7dVZjG4SbZonCe7nZXgLGKjYKCkDRZLRH9s.jpg)

After doing all those errands under the heat of the sun, I felt very tired and hungry. Before continuing my schedule, I decided to stop at a food place in Tacurong City to rest and eat. 


![1000204309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2qe7giSet92Bez8oqJej6Upvbpu8QMC5yJEAB6pDXB9p1bhVxzKfjsuMSKoFbmqE2f.jpg)

The moment I entered the restaurant, I immediately felt happy because there were so many delicious foods to choose from. They offered desserts, refreshing drinks, burgers, rice toppings, and many more. Their sweets and desserts looked very tempting, and I noticed that many customers were ordering them too.


![1000204445.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vi2AXteMX4UNM8FjD6xeGtp4qEDdbKw54BwaknvpuyuntPsW2myS5FuHDEwuy5m1brG.png)


![1000204444.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wqkWJBAoycdTreTsjn3fHi3wvcYnxGnLg9vawDExtooJVW8Mv8E5WP4EKkL6oAtVNFK.png)

Of course, I ordered some of my favorite comfort foods. I chose palabok, molo soup, fried lumpia, and my ultimate favorite drink  Coke. Honestly, after my first bite, I instantly felt my energy coming back. Good food truly makes everything better after a stressful day. Everything tasted delicious, and I felt so full and satisfied after eating.



![1000204300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wX7dBfD9dkwrZ4UXx6eFeFjjWhST98yVRgcbJa7c31MDb1ov1G5z5BhiLQZZsovznsR.jpg)

While enjoying my meal, I noticed that the restaurant was filled with customers. It was obvious that many people keep coming back because of the good service and the quality taste of the food. The place had a warm and lively atmosphere, which made my short break even more enjoyable.

After eating, I continued my day and went to our parish to meet with the priest and our PPC officers. We discussed the activities for our fiesta and talked about which activities are allowed and which are not. Sometimes we have ideas that we really want to include, but there are rules that need to be followed. There are moments when it feels a little disappointing, but I understand that proper communication and understanding are very important to make everything peaceful and organized. We need to face and accept the fact that there's a limitation in everything. 


![1000204297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2sRE8bWB1LShcp33uoZzwJzuXsKAPxV8t2TdWR3iz7gwbvmtdFU8DNzFnwWXgp6pC6.jpg)


Even though I ended the day feeling exhausted, I was still happy and thankful because everything became productive that day. 

Thank you for reading my story, this is my own picture and edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

Hello everyone, I hope you all are well. It's been a while since I wrote something here. Even though I was active as a silent user every day, I didn't feel like sharing or writing anything. I kept in touch with many Hivers; I just didn't feel inspired to write or share my stories. I had a feeling that whatever is happening in my life, writing about it doesn't make sense. But to be honest, due to my previous posts, I got many contacts from the outside world, which I never thought of. People outside of Hive read my posts (I don't know how) and reached out to me for different purposes. That actually made me happy, and somehow I felt that my posts had some use cases. Some people still ask me about life in Ukraine, read or watch my posts, videos, and try to talk to me. It's interesting to see how the digital world works nowadays, even though AI is taking over many sectors. So, what have I been doing these days? The answer is nothing much, still the same old life. I didn't achieve much, and I didn't create any successful memories. But mentally, I am better than before and can handle my daily life. I have difficulties, and I see my therapist once a month, so I can say I succeeded. I finished doing a lot of courses to upskill for my future career. I still have severe depression and hard days, but I guess I have to live with it. Some things will stay forever, and that can't be changed; that's okay. I feel more mature now, and I try to learn every day from my daily life. I am not super active or full of energy, yet I manage to complete some tasks every day. I have come a long way, and I guess I will continue going forward. I hope atleast...
![20250530_190715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/priyanarc/23zbHWdDTfEKU8YgJpoE4Hp55fAhxoCDJyjAHp45SfaLaRVStr6CE7fX3BHDHSZy3hDCe.jpg)
I haven't traveled much lately, mostly because I lack energy and also have an attachment to my dog Gigi. I don't know why, but sometimes I find it difficult to take a break from everyday life. Besides, everything nowadays is very expensive. Or maybe because I have a goal now, so I am not focusing on going somewhere for vacation. I am looking for a job according to my skills to build my career, and it's hard. I started learning the Dutch language by myself and also use Duolingo and books to learn the language. I keep forgetting words and verbs, but the most difficult part for me is speaking due to pronounciation. Because my way of talking is different, no one speaks Dutch with me and quickly switches to English since they don't understand what I am saying. I haven't lost hope yet, and to keep myself inspired, I started learning the Japanese language. There are reasons for learning Japanese, to be honest. I watch tons of animes everyday plus, watch Japanese shorts and videos. Moreover, somehow, for me, pronouncing the Japanese language is much easier than the Dutch language. So, as a hobby I started learning Japanese, and in 2 weeks I made a lot of progess than in Dutch, which I have been learning for the past 2 months. I also applied for the language school, but due to long waiting lists for free basic courses, I was not so lucky to get instant language classes. So, I am on the waiting list. I understand Dutch if someone speaks slowly with me, and I can read Dutch sentences as well. My sister always makes jokes with me when it comes to language. Because I never learned any language properly in life except English. So, I really hope one day I will be able to speak basic Dutch atleast to survive. I also saw that many people are using AI Agent Claude to learn language. I haven't looked into it yet.
| ![20260319_112011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/priyanarc/23zbHWduVS3ftC9TdKDM8v8RL4dvnpdbBAQk2rnJbuyH3prT7nBeQNGpQ3vWYwiZVpeMc.jpg) |![20260319_112019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/priyanarc/23x12ibpvrzRepghpFEAGWKooE5h6uCsphYtFPCptLVruhPuN3KiksrF2j2USgZpnAX9P.jpg)| |----------- |------------------------ | --- We had a beautiful Sakura week in March, and I took a lot of photos and videos back then. But I somehow deleted them and was left with these two photos. The place where I stay currently has a nice park nearby where the Sakura bloom. I go out with Gigi every day and walk around the park. Gigi's birthday is coming, and she will be 6 years old if I am not wrong. Time flies really because she is a full-grown adult Labrador now. I am trying to integrate with Dutch culture and system, knowing the difficulties. I don't know when and how things will be better or normal for me, or I guess this is just a new normal life for me. I don't know yet. There is a lot of anger, frustration, and depression living inside me, but that's just who I am right now. I believe eventually there will be a way for me in the future, whether in the Netherlands or somewhere else. But until then, my daily life fight and struggle continues... Until next time...

# How much is enough ? ![20260513_104748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/Eokf5yGC3UoXs1wMKv1y1MAjZip9geHj9ix6mzoAZHErHd4NucoKnosfLBYn364aNpb.jpg) Came back from my native after spending a week with my parents and I was very happy to see things going a little better now. Four months after the surgery, Mom has kind of adjusted to his new health condition without the gall bladder. When they remove it, they barely tell you the full consequences and you realize the reality only after facing and there is nothing that you can do. We even consulted the doctor about the occasional pain she was getting and other than counseling her to bear with patience, there was no other treatment done. Human psychology is wired for adaptation and changing her perspective and shifting her mindset has probably helped her a lot. Now all they look forward is to live the quietest phase of life with contentment - the Ultimate Flex. ![20260513_083932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23uQvaMHi4wG37uMu4mnTynBfX86JpuZqTGeXB38Yb8WRWmMxioH9KPPhW6Hhp6YDeifh.jpg) Dad has only one agenda - bring him the cash to manage the house ( he just pays the fund, but we want him to continue doing that, so that his mind is happy as he was a Banker), so he expects me to come at least once in a month and get the funds needed for monthly expenses, from bank. He is absolutely outside of the digital world and has no interest in even exploring them. This city never ceases to amaze me. Even though it's no longer a tourist destination, it still has a touristy feel in many ways, and there are still many tourists and foreigners around. Walking around I found some beautiful, pretty villas, almost all decorated with wisteria, which I confess I don't appreciate very much, not so much for its aesthetics. It's a beautiful plant, but it has a smell that I don't like. Then, in the villas, there were lots of beautiful flower gardens, also with beautiful roses and other plants. A woman approached us while we were at the mall the other day. She kind of just glided over to us and said, "Oh my gosh, they're beautiful," in reference to our daughters. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNgC8HyfbXRHt4ycTTC3mpPaDne5MUBrovZdyVmjkEer/1779376773115.jpg)

We said thank you, and then she unloaded it all onto us: "I never had kids, and now I cry myself to sleep about it every night -- I'll probably cry right after we part ways."
------------------

I looked at this woman; she appeared to be middle-aged, headed towards her 60s. She also appeared very distraught. 

But more than all of this, when I looked at her, I saw what could have been me. 

I told this woman that not long ago, I had come to the same conclusion. At the age of 15, I had already decided that I was NEVER having children (or so I thought).
-------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXqrzi4N6JsgwKP4sxbQPXpAaPN9FNBC9B3gmtmW7fL8M/1779376905421.jpg)

For one, I believed that I would never possess the ability to handle babies and children. For another, I was selfish and didn't want to bear those responsibilities. Lastly, I was cynical, the classic "I don't want to bring up children in this terrible world" trope.

I am grateful to have found my husband and happy to have had my mind changed. Yet, all the more reason why encountering this woman really struck a chord with me. 

Her story -- her decision -- is not one that I hear of often: the regret of willingly choosing not to have children.
---------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ1Jms6KdaiazSXAWE4sKmSFFzo9EvhiH2Y1pwZWjJwYm/1779376971755.jpg)

Most of the time, I only hear one of the two scenarios: either women who are broken because they physically cannot have children, or women who are ecstatic that they never had children. Yet, here was THIS woman, going on to explain how she has 24 nieces and nephews that she never sees because family have stopped talking to one another. 

My heart did break for this woman. I could not imagine a regret so deep that I am left in tears... 

I recognize my blessings. I recognize what a blessing it is to be able to conceive, to carry a pregnancy to term, to have healthy children. 
--------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeNpdc1qSkNUNLJAtoWHs9pYNA4jd9nNBGMNBWgNouzTw/1779377114530.jpg)

I think other people are starting to recognize it too, for yesterday alone, three different people came up to comment on the beauty and blessing of our girls. One little boy came up to hold their hands -- he was so smitten, he didn't want to leave us! Witnessing something so pure, innocent, and caring truly stirs my heart...

Stories are susceptible to a million different chapters, and I am eternally grateful that mine have involved my family 💗👨‍👩‍👧‍👧
------------------

I then took @stryeyz to work, then the boys to school, then hooked the trailer back up again and drove down to the east Spokane Home Depot to rent this trencher. ![IMG_20260520_084642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhui3dLZpXqowrwXv8NopwPLAWkuXjwPwykFFqDGQZ9KBLbPDgmwwZrxbt76rc2htPY.jpg) By a little after 9am I was unloaded and mapping out where I would be trenching. ![IMG_20260520_094045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWrjULPxGcKEy5hqeoj6g36dGu6qXgNKMLRhH3vqUspGFqAP4vKAwubP2gLWKAjCP2Q.jpg) I was very careful with the gas line nearby and made sure to dig around to make sure it was deep enough. ![IMG_20260520_094736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xVEmkxGvGP8Z658rotsNAjoHJzqmjy5JJxzs4829MAWXKju2NmuMWeyizuHWX14A3Uz.jpg) I trenched across the back yard after getting the front yard trenched. ![IMG_20260520_104157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u63KRJgisHp4fCR9edWYysX6tRDfYPDSb8g2XRT5ZNDzxdhnjdWYLkQZaSxfKWupxdP.jpg) And the little strip along the garage where I installed the gates at. ![IMG_20260520_104206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u5vfMrgjs653EBNWmJTmFvA8jKomo1ZxGZ8dikRhLFZiA7AMhnpwtZFVtcZD7X2WBJP.jpg) I will have to pull up a couple courses of bricks to hand trench the line across. The decayed bricks will get replaced sometime this summer most likely and a relevel of the rest. ![IMG_20260520_104211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xyNRn56drLLCa4eYTYQFMi1g7nS8PFF8pxSMb6gCRwD1RzmB63BoYuQhBNwJp3TVoVM.jpg) The side gate required a better latch which I installed as the poodles are good sized dogs and must be kept in the yard given the proximity to the road. ![IMG_20260520_104638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWropVZhbKMSDk5H3ygbsXUJ47fw8ezgLnDScz4pKeq51z4Uzuz4AEkysQJt85gG7P9.jpg) This end and the back yard will get 2 zones of pop-ups, one zone the end and one zone the back. ![IMG_20260520_104648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFPkaETQW68KhWPwsx7Ztq8x9RuQoiDZGxNhNaVQJkcSqFpJJcFJvEdYDxCZuUFKDJW.jpg) This is where the valve box goes and I have to run the system off a hose bib for now since there are no other water lines stubbed out of the house. ![IMG_20260520_105214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uQiGwmymS9h2gUuLu29CUPyUZ3Y8zEHkGhHs13CFoweZwtV7sARTWJpwPUiFWHzoEjB.jpg) I have to make an adjustment to the trench by the chimney as an A/C unit will be going in so need to do a jog around where the pad will likely go. ![IMG_20260520_105332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wMRdq4Mi6p4LDbbZvPDWxaeWxBj3TQCQ1tbyi1ndFqRXXdMhxAd5CtQM8nJXVaW9yMT.jpg) In the front I trenched AROUND the lawn so as to minimize the damage to the main field. ![IMG_20260520_105943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wgAxQ4wfQinNv6H4UDsGc25T5BRiEEwUhj4tYskxdh8TdMNXXThqqSEkN5zyEqrrrnh.jpg) The front will be broken into 2 zones of rotors, the north and south sides. ![IMG_20260520_105948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23yJ659Y2tTZ8iK99hE9yxt56VpMkGeZYoPkrYMWZ1k5ibbopiERq8ZUfhxs5zuHjcPHL.jpg) With the trenching done I loaded the trencher back onto the trailer and headed BACK to the valley to return it. Nicely it was just the 4 hr rate. ![IMG_20260520_113656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23zGc6VW9zG8LPdJHQMB83suKzc8onQggz1yAEyNddufEcqUaLvE11wM3ocQsKZZLs2K2.jpg) I then drove back towards home but stopped at Horizon to pickup the rest of the parts I need for the irrigation install. ![IMG_20260520_123341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWntkS3EBeErNMLTftip1gayt8P6aPmy5iAN9my4PzdVrB5SqmFzAskcQLPKWq6dVvQ.jpg) I looked around on the hill for the alpaca and ended up seeing her upside down at the top of the hill, stuck on her side. So I climbed up the hill and rolled her over to let her try and regain her senses. Not sure how long she was like that. She was on the side of the hill and after we ate dinner I noticed she had flopped to head down hill. I hiked back up and drug her to a level-ish spot where she could more easily rest. I will check on her this morning and hope she has made it overnight. ![IMG_20260520_184241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tSQAjVjie2wLzod82VXA5P4Uyd6Fkox5CxSADADizoRWY2GgpBRj16JeUyNMZ5uVGE5.jpg) Top of the damn hill... ![IMG_20260520_184259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tva9ptga4RXVZtGfHA1c2yCdwsUkLRhCpYBePMR5yRwZmSMjt5RHJcgH38yCyM4wCvC.jpg) I was gathering parts for today and went in the garden shed to hear skittering and found I had caught a mouse in one of the old bee packages. ![IMG_20260520_185359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmDZT3r2MdggKm5A8hf6exPBVRrqbaXukxCBHA2XywvmTk5jB3MXbYrJkPDZEbX9Xeg.jpg) 10 years on Hive happened last night... Yay me? Today I get the boys to school then have to load up everything for the install, stop at N40 for weed fabric, then go install the new irrigation system. This afternoon I have to pick R up after STEM. I am so sore and slept like shit last night so today will hopefully not be too rough on my body. ---

result.body: _Hello dear friends,__ And another year has gone by. Nine years ago, I signed up for the blockchain that later became HIVE. As far as I can remember, it must have been May 17, 2017, when it happened. Well, it was a life-changing decision that I still don’t regret to this day. On the contrary, I’ve met so many cool people here. 🚴🚴🚴🚴 __Hallo liebe Freunde,__ _und wieder ist ein Jahr vergangen. Vor 9 Jahren habe ich auf der Blockchain angemeldet, aus der dann später HIVE hervorgegangen ist. Soweit ich mich erinnere, muß es damals der 17. Mai 2017 gewesen sein, als es geschah. Nun, es war eine einschneidende Entscheidung, die ich bis heute nicht bereue. Im Gegenteil, so habe ich hier doch viele coole Leute getroffen._ ![20260508_171455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/242XyQaUWYARNzsTrKywiFmcrr59xDT7zY8HN3yWUFw9tox4Hoik2iTcNhPr7B8Kpi9HX.jpg) ___________________________________________________________________________ ![20260429_182059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/242NYJ6vAiezvVqhXCNSxBmK7ELsbTTaLkHg4pKzp32CxBFp7s6S9b3nudeDJhE1u2yNU.jpg) One thing never changes. My HIVE birthday falls on the day after my “real” birthday. So, of course, it's easy for me to remember the date for HIVE. ;-) 🚴🚴🚴🚴 _Eines ändert sich nicht. Mein HIVE Geburtstag fällt um einen Tag versetzt mit meinem "echten" Geburtstag zusammen. Daher kann ich mir das Datum für HIVE natürlich gut merken._ ;-) ![20260508_173204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/244e8XfEKEV4xo7k2LrGkLbtoTbDE17bqBUykb92opxFiUirb5ww9TXRBCBau7x53JrB2.jpg) ___________________________________________________________________________ ![20260508_170007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/244KEjv1X59TwjRq9Wpk4ju7aqtcfn1n9z1yEcYRddpwCZVPraKWpqpYZmE9rE2WQoMJ9.jpg) In the lovely month of May, we finally had some consistently warmer days. At least until the Ice Saints, who once again lived up to their reputation. Of course, I took advantage of that to go on lots of short bike rides on my eMTB. I took all of the photos above in the Schenkenwald forest, which is currently under serious threat of having to make way, in no small part, for wind turbines. That would mean losing my personal oasis of well-being. Hopefully, it won’t come to that. 🚴🚴🚴🚴 _Im Wonnemonat Mai hatten wir ja endlich konstant schon wärmere Tage. Zumindest bis zu den Eisheiligen, die ihrem Ruf mal wieder alle Ehre gemacht haben. Das habe ich natürlich wieder für viele kurze Radtouren auf meinem eMTB genutzt. Die obigen Bilder habe ich allesamt im Schenkenwald gemacht, der aktuell leider akut bedroht ist, zu einem nicht unerheblichen Teil für Windkraftanlagen weichen zu müssen. Damit würde ich meine persönliche Wohlfühloase verlieren. Hoffentlich kommt es nicht dazu._ ![20260504_183525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/244KGggAXbS5JnDk2RxV2ZNuX6w3juHxfzSGrmDejiPRLSu67DGr7XfJror6ebuwYpTMo.jpg) ___________________________________________________________________________ ![20260518_133654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23zktsW7VnhFNVeRJxjRBGut8iLiwhHkxFSbSAngwuJUt6sMSaiibxy2DECMwUSLdHNA7.jpg) You can also spot some interesting animals now... 🚴🚴🚴🚴 _Auch einige interessante Tiere kann man nun entdecken..._ ![20260419_190316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23ynNWnocGeQNduwpTqux7gz73eZYyQdAXrjJzEw35U4Y6kHPLyidWpK8PAnrGELPpRoH.jpg) ___________________________________________________________________________ ![20260508_163402.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23yJGFYFyn1Jv1JSBXdgPTuGW2v1AaN8U1H63NoSSGbCr6xUbcpxbeoJSPQnn47N89kdp.jpg) Hawthorn is good for the heart. And it’s a pleasure to look at, too. 🚴🚴🚴🚴 _Weissdorn ist gut für das Herz. Und schön für das Auge zudem._ ___________________________________________________________________________ ![20260423_182428.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/245mg2SHNR3SaHaqRyGtrpuHiWNH8yeQM23qNv7TUA8SUvRfeKdGLM6725cBkcF4KQcCw.jpg) Our outdoor pool opened a week earlier this year than in previous years. I generally like to visit our local swimming lakes before the outdoor swimming season starts. There are two of them near me. However, the spring was very chilly. We couldn’t go in the water without getting frostbite until May. In previous years, I was already swimming frequently as early as April. 🚴🚴🚴🚴 _Unser Freibad hat dieses Jahr eine Woche früher aufgemacht als die letzten Jahre. Grundsätzlich gehe ich gerne vor der Freibadsaison an unsere Badeseen. Wir haben hier zwei davon in meiner Nähe. Das Frühjahr war allerdings sehr kühl. Man konnte erst am Mai ohne Frostbeulen ins Wasser. Die Jahre davor war ich stets schon im April oft baden._ ![20260426_185928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23ua8rh2iyNWeeCJDhvgBifyHViXHTMHdGjHhi58PqH8GKGogvy9h8SqcNsv1JzWsyktC.jpg) ![20260423_184646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23zRvdrjTeLqVRVyFVX1cqGPiRxBEGEC7hniyk1S11469bZM1Quco5btpqCQSgpTRWtxz.jpg) ___________________________________________________________________________ ![20260516_185933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23zv7AmMnkM53t5LhcFuD2uhHAhbSFqJvoqAC1LzjWFn4Pu3Ej5QiYn99FVhuyDHyfDZ2.jpg) This is another lovely spot where I often stop to recharge my batteries in a meditative way. Hier sieht mal im Grund nie eine Menschenseele, obwohl man doch nur etwas mehr als ein paar Steinwürfe von Wertheim entfernt ist. Ich hoffe, mein kurzer Beitrag hat Euch gefallen. 儿子参加英语听力口语考试后，我的心啊，一直都是悬着的——虽然他说考得不错，考试内容也很简单，应该能打满分，但是万一失误了呢？


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9oEwMbJ8Rq3rfnDLSFrH3kkc6kFMGXrjVTh8FAMeoPL/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

什么生地实验、理化实验、中考体测都是当场出分，考试后要签成绩单后才算完成，所以孩子考完也就知道了分数。

但英语听力口语考试却是大不同，要等一个多月才会出成绩，对于我这种容易焦虑的人来说，真是重大的考验呀。

我总担心他有没有听错内容、填错选项、回答问题错误等等等等，甚是担心犯一些低级错误，比如说考号啥的填错——之前学校的考试（周考、期中、期末等），他可没少犯这样的错误。

英语听力口语模拟考试的时候，他还大翻车一次，在没有听到提示音的时候，就抢先回答问题——虽然之后一再强调要注意这点，但真怕他在这个环节再次翻车。不过还好，考试后他和我说确定没犯同样的错误。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSuozdeQu3J3EBLjfdx6cr9vRRYWTXHky747QNrkmFg1r/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

反正考试后就是焦急地等待，等了近一个月，昨天网上有人说，可以查成绩啦。媳妇去查了一下，儿子的英语听力口语满分。

不过等我再去查的时候，就提示查询功能尚未开放，说是到晚上八点才会开放。我晕，我又开始焦虑了，虽然媳妇截屏的成绩单写着儿子的名字和成绩，但是既然查询未开放，那这个成绩是不是系统随机生成的测试数字呢？

就好比有时周末没开盘时打开股票账户，看持仓里好多股票涨停，再仔细一看，才发现都是假象，是交易所或者券商再调试系统而已。

所以昨天又深度焦虑了大半天，直到晚上八点后再次登录系统，亲眼看到了儿子英语听力口语满分的成绩，心里的一块大石头总算落地啦。

从别的群里反馈的信息来看，绝大部分孩子英语听力口语测试都拿到了满分，就好像生地、理化实验、体测一样。

但孩子真的拿到了满分还是很高兴的，不然别人都拿满分，咱们再在这么简单的事情上丢分，那会更叫人郁闷呢。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaE6G95WS7SxjQD9DCyarwivCcxEQfTnrmLLaw3VgQvg1/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

至此，中考的前置考试，均已尘埃落定，就只剩一次最重要的考试啦，说不焦虑那是假的，但是焦虑又有什么办法呢？顺其自然吧。

我们家长要做的就是给孩子做好服务，别把焦虑传染给孩子，考场上的战斗只能靠他自己啦。

Sometimes, it is absolutely insane how many "utility lines" appear in photos I've taken over the years. Even out in the country, it's often difficult to snap a photo of a barn in a field beside the road without catching a couple of power lines somewhere in the shot.

I thought the Queen Anne-inspired house in the following photo was lovely and wanted a picture of it. Many, many years ago, I lived just a couple blocks from that house and passed it almost every day on my to work, church, shopping, or some other destination. While revisiting the area a few years ago, I decided to stop my car long enough to get a quick snap of it. When I took the photo, I noticed there were some utility lines in the shot, but thought I would edit them out, using my trusty PaintShopPro™ software, as I have done countless times in the past.

"Countless times," you may ask...? Yes, no exaggeration. I have spent hours upon hours, editing hundreds of photos, carefully using tools such as the Clone Brush and Push Brush, tediously removing the lines. Then one must re-blend the affected areas with the Smudge Brush and Clone Brush to smooth the tones of the blue sky, the trees, and anything else that the power lines crossed.

Closer inspection of the photograph on my computer screen revealed a veritable nightmare of editing that lay in front of me. Not only are there clearly visible lines and cables in the shot, but zooming into different areas show wispy traces of lines here-and-there. To help demonstrate what I'm talking about, look at the following, where I have traced the lines — and I know there are others that I failed to trace, but my eyes were quite bleary by this point! LOL! It would take hours of work to clean up this mess in a halfway acceptable manner.

For those that might be confused by the plethora of wires and cables, I can explain. Some of the wires and cables shown in the photo provide electrical service to the area, while others carry telephone signals for landline phones or cable-TV signals (each provider has their own cables). There are likely cables for other purposes up there of which I am unaware, such as security systems, traffic-light control, and so forth. The steel cables that are seen slicing diagonally through the image are "guy wires" that are used to secure the big utility poles to help keep them from toppling in high winds, or if a vehicle loses control and strikes one.

My laptop came pre-loaded with an AI app (Copilot™), but I'd never used it until recently when I asked it to help enhance/restore some old family photos. It did a great job restoring and enhancing the old, faded photos! I honestly do not know what made me think of this next idea, but one day I decided to see if it could assist in removing utility lines and poles. OMG, it did it, beautifully in just a couple of minutes! The result is shown below!

One thing that truly amazed me: If you scroll back up to the first photo in the post and look closely, you will notice that the brown utility pole was casting a shadow on the house (to the immediate right of the first upstairs window). When the AI removed the pole, it also removed the shadow of that pole on the house, without my having to ask it to do so! 😯

So below is the final edit by me in PaintShopPro™ where I removed the hood of my car from the bottom of the photo as well as the shadow of another utility pole across the pavement. I probably could have asked the AI to do that, too, but I've learned (the hard way) that running a photo thru the AI too many times often introduces other errors, even when "change nothing else" is specified in the prompt. 😒

All I used for a prompt was "remove utility poles and utility lines from the attached photo, perserve details of the house."

Please don't misunderstand: I do not intend for this to be a turning point where my future images will be heavily touched by AI. I will still be editing photos and applying filters manually with PaintShopPro™ and other tools, but will definitely use AI's assistance here-and-there as each case warrants.

Also: ➡️ I will not use AI for writing — not even proofreading or translating! ⬅️

I hope my sharing this tip will help others edit their photos faster and easier! If you have any similar tips, please share them in the comments!

**NOTES** * All writing is always by me with NO AI used, not even for proofreading. * Photos by me, with enhancement by Copilot™ AI

English
Hello friends, I hope you are doing great! Today I want to share with you my latest illustration of one of the Healers using a skateboard. I must say that I finished this drawing a few days ago, but due to time constraints, I couldn't upload it until now. I also didn't want to make a quick post without explaining things properly. Do the healers have names? Wow, I don't know them. Recently, I was watching an anime called "Your Name"—yes, I know it has been out for a while, but I just watched it recently. The point is that I wanted to integrate something from it into my illustration; maybe those who watched the anime have already noticed it. The format of the drawing, as I mentioned before, will continue to be in a card style just in case it gets selected. Well friends, I hope you like it!

I had also thought at this point that it would be an illustration without a background. This was the result. >Primeros pasos: crear el boceto y lineart. I added shadows to the character's body and clothing. This time, I didn't use noise textures or anything similar. Hice unos efectos usando el pincel de neón; este mismo pincel lo usaré más adelante en el efecto del cometa en el cielo. Agregué las sombras al cuerpo del personaje y en la ropa.
